subject: Proposal: mid-cycle role consolidation and review-dependent backfill
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-cycle proposal: consolidate SRE II and Platform IC roles

Hi team,

Following the mid-cycle calibration and the individual review notes (see attached redacted review_notes_redacted.txt), I want to propose a consolidation of the SRE II and Platform IC roles on Platform Services into a single Senior Platform Engineer role. The rationale: scope overlap on infra automation, repeated on-call escalations for the same subsystems, and upside in cross-training a single owner for the ingestion pipeline.

High-level ask: approve a temporary hiring freeze exception to allow a 6-month interim contractor (or a short-term internal backfill) for on-call coverage while we finalize the consolidated role description and complete leveling/comp discussions during end-of-year reviews.

Why temporary backfill is necessary:
- On-call coverage risk: current rotations will have single-person gaps if we remove headcount before coverage plan complete.
- Product delivery: two ongoing milestones (ingest hardening, cache migration) have tight Q1 timelines.
- Performance/people sensitivity: consolidation is tied to review outcomes and 1:1 coaching windows — we must not make immediate permanent cuts during a live review window.

Attached: role_consolidation_draft.pdf (initial JD + responsibilities), org_chart_v3.png.

Ask of you (quick):
- Markus: can you sign off on the temporary exception rationale/coverage plan?
- Laura: will you own quantifying the short-term budget delta (estimated cost of contractor vs. hiring) and the mutual action plan for leveling?
- Priyom: can you draft a short comms plan for the affected team that preserves confidentiality during review windows?

I left Mina on cc for HR guidance on what documentation we need for an exception. I’ve tried to keep this minimal and reversible so we don’t impact comp or the review process.

Thanks — Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Platform Services
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle proposal: consolidate SRE II and Platform IC roles

Sofia — thanks for the summary and attachments. I skimmed the draft JD. A few quick reactions:

- I agree consolidation reduces duplication, but we need a concrete on-call mitigation plan before I can approve any headcount change. Specifically: who owns pager coverage for the 03:00 EST window that currently falls to the SRE II?
- Budget: short-term contractor rate will likely be higher than the current blended IC comp. Put rough numbers in the sheet and I’ll route to finance.
- Performance sensitivity: I don’t want consolidation to look like a punitive move mid-review. Any comms must be explicit that this is a role redesign tied to product priorities and not a unilateral headcount reduction.

A couple of asks from my side:
1) Sofia — can you add a 2-week shadow period in the plan so the nominated owner can ramp before we remove the other role from rotation?
2) Laura — if you can throw me an expected delta (contractor monthly vs. payroll monthly) I can pre-approve the exception subject to HR checklist completion.

Thanks,
Markus

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 9:18 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted]
>
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle proposal: consolidate SRE II and Platform IC roles

Folks — I pulled comp and contractor estimates (high-level):
- Current blended monthly comp expense for the two roles on payroll: ~$42k/mo (base + benefits + taxes).
- Estimated interim contractor (senior platform contractor) market rate: $18k–$25k/mo depending on term and guarantee.
- Net short-term delta: approx +$3k–$8k/mo if we move to contractor coverage while we reorganize.

I support the consolidation on product grounds, with two caveats:
1) We must preserve traceable documentation for the review decisions (redacted notes are fine) and the mutual action plan so affected ICs have a clear path and timeline. HR will need the redacted review artifacts and a manager summary.
2) Operationally, add Markus’s 2-week shadow + an explicit on-call backup rota for the next 3 months. Put that rota into the monthly ops report.

I created a short mutual action plan and added a DocuSign placeholder for the temporary contractor agreement: https://redwood.app/proposals/RC-2026-11
Attached the updated org_chart_v3.png with a proposed interim headcount mapping.

If we can agree, Markus — can you confirm you’ll sign the coverage plan? Mina — is HR able to provision an exception with those artifacts?

Cheers,
Laura

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:02 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> [quoted for context]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme PeopleOps <peopleops@acmeco.com>, contracts@vendorlegal.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle proposal: consolidate SRE II and Platform IC roles — HR provisional exception

Thanks everyone — appreciate the careful framing. HR can provision a provisional hiring freeze exception for up to 90 days (extendable with Exec sponsor approval) provided the following items are received:

1) Manager summary memo (Sofia) outlining the scope change and why consolidation is product-driven, with redacted review notes attached (we already have the redacted file).
2) Coverage plan documented with 2-week shadow and a 3-month rota (Markus).
3) Budget delta worksheet (Laura) and confirmation from Finance that temporary contractor spend is acceptable within current departmental variance.
4) Mutual action plan for affected employees and a communications draft (Priyom).

Next steps:
- Sofia: please upload the manager memo to the HR exception form: https://hr.redwood.internal/exceptions (I’ve added the link to our internal workflow).
- Laura: email the budget worksheet to finance@redwood.com and cc HR.
- Markus: upload the rota to the operations folder and reply-all with confirmation of sign-off.

HR will queue this for provisional approval and run a light-side legal review with our contract partner (contracts@vendorlegal.com). Acme PeopleOps is on cc to assist with contractor sourcing if you choose that route.

Provisional approval conditions: once the four items are received we will issue an exception letter to the department within 48 business hours. Final extension beyond 90 days requires Exec sponsor sign-off (I’ll route to SVP Product if needed).

If anyone prefers a quick call to align before documentation, I’m available tomorrow at 10:00 or 15:00 PT.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations (Interim)
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199
